name: Belmond Hotel Cipriani
positioning: Belmond's Hotel Cipriani, founded by Giuseppe Cipriani on Giudecca Island across the lagoon from St Mark's Square, with a main building, a 15th-century Palazzetto annex and several waterside dining spots
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet island base reached by boat
Guests who like gardens, a spa and private boat trips to Murano and Burano

facts.text: The hotel was built on a three-acre plot at the tip of Giudecca Island.
In 1976 the hotel became the cornerstone of the Belmond collection.
Palazzo Vendramin is one of the additions made to the hotel since Giuseppe Cipriani built it.
Guests can play tennis on the hotel's red-clay court, including against a professional tennis player.
The Buona Notte cocktail was created at the hotel by George Clooney and head barman Walter Bolzonella.
The Giudecca 10 trattoria has tables arranged along a waterside terrace.
Guests can snack by the pool at Porticciolo.
Guests can arrive at the hotel's private dock or take the hotel launch from Piazza San Marco across the lagoon.
The Oro restaurant has an interior designed by Adam Tihany.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private mahogany motorboat named Shirley that carries up to ten passengers and takes guests to Murano and Burano.
Giuseppe Cipriani, founder of Harry's Bar in Venice, decided to build the hotel in 1956.
Every unit in the main building has its own water-facing or garden-facing balcony.
The Palazzetto annex dates back to the 15th century.
The spa is set in the gardens where Casanova once wooed his lovers.

considerations.text: The hotel is on Giudecca Island, so guests reach it by its private dock or by the hotel launch from Piazza San Marco across the lagoon.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
